text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a break after finishing my work, I saw Karen Bouquet Doll looking unusually flustered. When our eyes met—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san—I found you.
So you were here.
Thank goodness, I wanted to tell you right away—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? The flower seeds.
Those seeds... have sprouted!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
It's still small, but—it's a wonderful sprout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Peeking out from the palm-sized pot placed on the grass was a lovely little sprout.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Once it grows a little more—I plan to repot it into a larger pot.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
A new home...
I wonder what kind would be best.
Fufu, even pondering it—is so delightful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the sprout swaying in the wind seemed delicate, it also radiated a strong will to live.
Feeling a sense of warmth from it—
choice_data_list: May I help pick one out with you?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
My, would that be all right?
Not only did you find a spot in the sunroom for it, but now a new home too...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'm certain this little one is delighted too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having heard that a specialized magazine featuring various pot designs was in the library, I came over with Karen Bouquetd'or, but...
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what kind of seeds are those...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to ask her what kind of flower it is.
The pot's design might change depending on that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—I hadn't told you yet, had I?
I'm sorry. Those are—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Sweet peas.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
When it was decided that I'd enroll in Tracen Academy...
some sweet pea seeds at home caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You might laugh, but...
"Take me with you," it felt like they were saying that to me—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, I just felt it.
'Ah, once this little one blooms... I'm sure it will comfort so many people's hearts.'

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...It might just be a silly fancy.
Even so, I can't help but hope that it comes true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I could feel a gentle warmth in Karen Bouquetd'or's words. It wasn't something meant to be flaunted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if no one ever notices, that's fine.
It feels like a kind, quiet wish, offered from the shadows like a gentle prayer.
choice_data_list: Then we really need to pick out a great pot!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—you're right.
There are plenty of options, so let's take our time choosing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking through the magazine gave us a rough idea.
For sweet peas, a cute basket-style pot seemed like the best choice.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it's a hanging type...
it'll easily catch everyone's eye.
...Mm, let's go with this type, then.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: Why don't we go look at the real thing?
Why don't we try making one by hand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though the magazine gave us an idea, seeing the real thing in person is essential.
choice_data_list: If we find a nice one, let's buy it and take it home.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...You'd even accompany me shopping?
Is it really alright for me to impose on you that much?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... ah, I'm sorry.
But... fufu.
I'm the one who's stronger, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Karen Bouquetd'or, giggling softly, looked just like a gently blooming flower.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Making it by hand... I hadn't thought of that at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might take time, but it would also become a fond memory. Every time we look at it, it might bring a smile to our faces.
choice_data_list: Let's look up how to make one!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Are you truly okay with that?
Um...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Karen Bouquetd'or look so apologetic, I told her I was looking forward to seeing the flowers bloom.
At that, she looked relieved—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I can hardly wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And smiled gently.
